title: Changing only a WordPress page's search title never renames the page: the plugin's own meta where it prints, else said
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-name-pattern='^seo:' packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/normalize.test.mjs
S4: Read the pass/fail counts and the test names of each run.
expect: A content.update {kind:"postmeta", key:"_claude_cowork_seo_title"} on WordPress resolves wpSeoMeta: on a Claude Cowork older than 0.18.0 with no SEO plugin it is refused SEO_TITLE_UNSUPPORTED (its next says the page title is the only title and renaming it renames the breadcrumb and heading); on 0.18.0+ it is sent, with a note when the title holds no site name.

With Yoast SEO or Rank Math active the key becomes _yoast_wpseo_title / rank_math_title (description: _yoast_wpseo_metadesc / rank_math_description); with All in One SEO, SmartCrawl, SureRank or Jetpack with seo-tools it is refused SEO_PLUGIN_FIELDS.
A post write's seo on an older plugin is refused (SEO_TITLE_UNSUPPORTED, or SEO_FIELD_DROPPED naming the SEO plugin's keys).
The Tracy Business wp7 where-map offers the _claude_cowork_seo_title entry (kind postmeta, value '<new page part> – <site name>') before the post_title entry, which says the breadcrumb changes too.
evidence: 05/10/2026, Tracy Business wp7 with no SEO plugin: asked to change only what Google shows, the agent renamed the page (the only where.seo entry), which renamed the breadcrumb in <main>; the plugin's seo:{title} had written nothing, silently. Plugin side: TracyHQ/claude-cowork#119.
fence: resolveSeo reads plugin.list and info before any _claude_cowork_seo_* or seo write leaves tracy_site
